data.title: Tile preview: add repeat 2x swatch between 4x and 1x

data.body: Implemented directly by the orchestrator (10-line additive change): third .tp-swatch 'repeat 2x' between 4x and 1x in src/preview/tile-preview.ts, background-size 2*cellSize, shared uri/repeat loop, header comment updated. tsc + build clean. Commit ac200d9.

Reviewed commit ac200d9 cold against plan. Verified: (1) three .tp-item entries in DOM order 4x, 2x, 1x, each with the existing lowercase mono span label ('repeat 2x' matches .tp-item span styling); (2) new 'doubled' swatch is included in the shared backgroundImage/backgroundRepeat loop ([native, doubled, zoomed]) so all three refresh from the same data URI, and gets backgroundSize cellSize*2 px on both axes; (3) commit touches only src/preview/tile-preview.ts (+6/-3, header comment updated); (4) npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build clean (35 modules); (5) grepped src/ and app.css for tp-swatch/tp-item/TilePreview consumers — main.ts only uses root/update, CSS has no per-column fixed height (.output has width only; .tp-swatch height 158px is per-swatch), so nothing assumed two swatches. Pre-existing observation, out of scope and not introduced here: refreshPreviews in main.ts sets tilePreview.root.style.display = '' which clears the inline display:grid set in createTilePreview, dropping the 12px gap between tile items; worth a follow-up task if seen again. Verdict: PASS, meets all acceptance criteria, no changes needed.
